### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

K3s - Lightweight Kubernetes =============================================== Lightweight Kubernetes.  Production ready, easy to install, half the memory, all in a binary less than 100 MB. Great for: * Edge * IoT * CI * Development * ARM * Embedding k8s * Situations where a PhD in k8s clusterology is infeasible What is this? K3s is a [fully conformant](https://github.com/cncf/k8s-conformance/pulls?q=is%3Apr+k3s) production-ready Kubernetes distribution with the following changes: 1. It is packaged as a single binary. 1.
